text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweeping aside the Overlord of the End of 
the Century, a furious late surge, and the 
world's fiercest contenders, Admire Vega 
stood at the very pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that, Narita Top Road swore to make 
a comeback— because she was the one who 
wanted to defeat Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having become an unrivaled first-magnitude 
star, Admire Vega returned from the race. 
Back to herself—the one who "tags along 
uninvited."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, with the faintest of smiles, she 
whispered, "You're always right there, 
aren't you?"
